narrative.overview: The site is a Kursbuch page: white paper, black ink, ruled rows, and a vertical route line with a station dot per company. Dates are departures, set in tabular figures. The current role is the train on the platform. Density is calm and editorial, with generous vertical gaps between ruled sections and a fixed 8.5rem left column that holds dates. One neo-grotesk (Archivo, variable weight and width) does all the work. Depth comes from rules and ink, not shadow. Red appears only for "now" and the primary action.
keyCharacteristics: Ruled structure: 3px ink rules open sections, 1px grey rules separate rows.
Left date column (8.5rem) aligned across board, route, post list, and resume.
Square corners everywhere except the station dots.
Tabular figures set on body, so every date and number aligns.
Print parity: the resume page drops chrome and becomes the PDF.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Red marks "now" or the one action to take, and nothing else. It is never decoration, never a section color.

rules.name: The Width Ladder Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy is weight plus font-stretch: 78-85% for display and headings, 90-95% for sub-lines and buttons, 100% for reading text.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums stays on at the body level so dates and metrics line up.

rules.name: The Flat Paper Rule
rules.body: Surfaces never lift. State change is a fill swap (white to ink, red to deep red) or a rule, never a shadow.

dos: Do use red only for the current role or position, status, and the single primary action.
Do keep dates in the left column in tabular figures.
Do separate sections with 3px ink rules and rows with 1px Rule Grey.
Do keep corners square and reserve circles for station dots.
Do keep focus visible: 2px signal outline with 3px offset.
Do keep the resume print-clean: hide header, footer, and .no-print controls; use mm and pt units.
donts: Don't add shadows, gradients, or blur.
Don't add a second accent color or color the sections.
Don't introduce a serif or a mono display face.
Don't add avatars, skill pills, or logo walls; proof is resume facts only.
Don't use red for body-size link text on white; use Signal Ink.
